description: Synthetic refinement cases and the 8fa6209 fresh-profile records rewritten in the inference.refine record form (rewrite rules: <rundir>/probes/probe_profile.py). Objective kinds: quadratic f = sum(w (x - t)^2) / 2; two_wells_min f = min(10 (x - 2.5)^2, 2 + 10 (x - 4)^2); two_wells_split f = 5 (x - 0.2)^2 for x < 0.5 else 1 + 50 (x - 0.8)^2; nan f = NaN. Residual [sqrt(2 f)], direct log L -f.
